quest.title: Risen Moon Chapter
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Talk to the Aranara that suddenly appeared

dialogues.text: Golden Nara and White Floaty, you are here! I am Aragaru!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Plants and mushrooms told me you would come, I have waited a very long time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh...? You know us...? Do you need us for something?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Yes! Something big, very big!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, slow down. Take your time.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Marana is growing, bigger and bigger. Forests are afraid to speak, afraid to breathe... Marana wants to eat them...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: To stop Marana, Aranaga is busy preparing the Arahaoma ritual. But Arahaoma... still needs the Barsam Flower.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon sees... But where can we find this Barsam Flower?

choices.text: Paimon, you got the name right this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heehee, Baaaarsaaam Flooower! Impressive, huh?

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: The Barsam Flower is at where mushrooms grow. The place was Nara's home many, many moonrises and moonsets ago.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: But then... wet dirt covered Nara's dreams, and new plants grew in their memories. They were dried up and reborn generation after generation... That is the kind of place we want to go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon doesn't quite understand, but it sounds pretty scary.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Not scary, not scary. Plants love places Nara are scared of. So, lots of plants there.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: There are runes left by Nara and Aranara there, for not forgetting and for recalling after forgetting. Go there and find the Barsam Flower!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Then let's go to the place Aragaru's talking about!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Oh, right! And also Kusava!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: With Kusava, Aranara strong, strong! Can clear the path for everyone! Aragaru can smash the rocks! Hah! Yah! Boom!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aragaru is so tiny, but so strong!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Hehe, yes, very strong! Hmm... But it has to be a cracked rock with green vines. Ones with no cracks, not strong enough to smash them.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Kusava holds memories and dreams. It is chubby, bitter, and full of power. It is the fruit of flowering plants, and also the seed of new life.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: This, for you. Take good care of it. Aranara only give this to important ones, so... do not eat it!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Hmm... Moon comes and goes, not much left now... Walking Shroom-Kin are always inside, increasing now... This is very bad, we must hurry.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Barsam Flower is Aranara's good friend and is born for Arahaoma. It is the source of the potion. Hmm... have to sacrifice juice to refine Arahaoma.

choices.text: It must be hard to find.

talks.objective: Use the Kusava to open up the path

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh! *cough* *cough* *cough* Wh—Why did so much water gush out!? Paimon almost got drowned!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Because the Realm of Khab is the Barsam Flower's dream. When the Barsam Flower wakes up, the dream will disperse into the air.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: So the weight of the water can't be withstood, and water will gush out! Whooo! Splash! Cool and refreshing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph... Let's see if you could still say the same if Paimon was washed away and never found back!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Hehe, Aragaru knows where Nara and White Floaty are. Plants can also tell me where you've gone. You'll be found!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: We have the Barsam Flower now, so next is to find the Zohrah Mushroom and the Yajna Grass before we can ask Aranaga to make the Arahaoma!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: #Yes, thanks to Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty! If it were Aranaga, he'd definitely say, "Just like Nara Varuna, you are..."

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: #Hehe, that is to say, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are amazing!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Go find my friend Aranaga. He surely has something that needs your help! You can find him in the Mawtiyima Forest!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All right, we got it!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Next... I'm going to the Mawtiyima Forest, too, to prepare for the Arahaoma ritual. Let's meet there!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Aranaga is the eldest and most interesting of us three! He can say a lot of funny things and he knows a lot about Nara.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: But he also forgot a lot about Nara... The three of us all have lots of things we can't remember. Some are scattered like pollen in the breeze, and some are blurred...

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: But Aranaga usually knows and remembers the most. That's why we like playing with Aranaga.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Aranaga is right in the gardens of the Mawtiyima Forest, watching over Mawtiyima. You'll definitely find him if you go there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

talks.objective: Investigate the rune surrounded by Fungi

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Here, look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this...? It looks like a child's drawing... What's it supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Memory! Aranara memories can store in tubers, in seeds, can flow in leaf veins... But Nara memories are carved in the stones!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Hehe, whenever the moon is high up in the sky, the three of us Aranara would come here, recall stories from the past, just like Nara!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Then what's in this drawing?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: It's not a drawing, it's a rune... It's a river of light, and in it are flower stems blooming with stars. The river and stars send us brave Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: The Grandmaster of Verdure cultivated the bud of wisdom in the hearts of brave Nara and let Aranara guide them... to the glimmering water cave.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Hmm... That's it. There are other runes nearby. Let's go and see them.
Golden Nara and White Floaty, you are here! I am Aragaru!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: The Realm of Khab is up ahead, outside the cave... But we must be careful on the way there.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: This earth is where Nara sleep. Once here were stone homes Nara made. But after they fell asleep, plants came from their dreams and became owners of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Does White Floaty understand?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not really...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Because Floaty is silly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, whose side are you on!?

talks.objective: Go to the cave where the Barsam Flower is located

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: This is the place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this is... blocked by vines? There's no way we can get in!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Hehe! Don't fret, White Floaty! Watch me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... How did you do that, Aragaru? Paimon wants to learn this!

choices.text: I don't think this sort of thing can be learned...

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Heh, Aragaru can talk with vines, so the vines will make way for Aragaru! The language of vines is like singing. It's hard to learn for Nara... But if Nara wants to learn, I will teach you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to learn! Please do teach Paimon later, Aragaru!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Okay, if I don't forget you!

talks.objective: Enter the place where the Barsam Flower is located

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: This is the Realm of Khab! This is where plants' sweet dreams hide!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: See? Growing over there is the Barsam Flower!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, a little bit too quiet... Paimon is having goosebumps...

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: The Realm of Khab is very weak... Shroom-Kin came in, ate lots of nutrients, but the Barsam Flower is not hurt... Not yet.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Let's go lift his seal, then talk to him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, we'll lift the seal. Then you can go talk to him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Why does it look so odd...?

talks.objective: Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Barsam Flower

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aragaru just needs to talk to the Barsam Flower, right?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Shh! Shh! Quiet, don't wake him.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Aragaru whispers with the Barsam Flower for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: The Barsam Flower was woken up from his dream by us, he is very angry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: But if it's for Arahaoma, then I suppose we can be forgiven.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Barsam Flower, Barsam Flower, for Arahaoma, for Mawtiyima's revival... Please join us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh... Ehh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is trying to listen to the Barsam Flower's response!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Great! The Barsam Flower agreed to adventure with us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! We got the Barsam Flower!

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Hmm, and... the Barsam Flower said be careful with our heads.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What does that mean?

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Protect our heads and roots, or damage will be caused when water comes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Wait... What is that sound?

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Watch out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Paimon can't hear anything.

response.speaker: Aragaru
response.text: Nara and white floaty must be careful. There are Naravaluka roaming about there. Aranakin calls them "sand"... You can't trust their words! They're bad!
